# Notebook 0 -- Hydrology configuration & library

Companion to the QED bias-correction workflow. Everything the hydrology
notebooks need lives here: paths, tiers source, model choice, PET settings,
calibration windows. **Edit values here only.**

Model choice (reviewed against Deshmukh et al. 2025 regionalization
manuscript): **GR4J via airGR** -- equal skill to HBV (median NSE 0.64 vs
0.63) with 4 instead of 15 parameters, no irrelevant snow module for
peninsular CAMELS-IND catchments, and inputs limited to pr + PET, which match
the bias-corrected CMIP6 variables exactly.

```{r paths}
hyd_project_root <- "D:/Datasets/CIMP6_India"

# QED workflow outputs (bias-corrected series + tiers)
hyd_qed_dir    <- file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_processed", "qed")
hyd_qm_corr_dir <- file.path(hyd_qed_dir, "qm_corrected")

# CAMELS-IND observations
hyd_camels_root <- file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_raw", "camels_ind_forcings")
hyd_forcing_dir <- file.path(hyd_camels_root, "catchment_mean_forcings")
hyd_streamflow_fp <- file.path(hyd_camels_root, "streamflow_timeseries",
                               "streamflow_observed.csv")
hyd_topo_fp <- file.path(hyd_camels_root, "attributes_csv", "camels_ind_topo.csv")

# Outputs of this workflow
hyd_output_dir <- file.path(hyd_project_root, "data_processed", "hyd")
hyd_inputs_dir <- file.path(hyd_output_dir, "model_inputs")   # <id>_obs.csv
```

```{r period-windows}
hyd_period_start <- as.Date("1981-01-01")
hyd_period_end   <- as.Date("2014-12-31")

# Split-sample windows (consistent with the QED_30 ranking design)
hyd_calib_start <- as.Date("1981-01-01")
hyd_calib_end   <- as.Date("2000-12-31")
hyd_valid_start <- as.Date("2001-01-01")
hyd_valid_end   <- as.Date("2014-12-31")

# airGR warm-up: first 365 days inside each run window
hyd_warmup_days <- 365L

# Quick-test mode: a handful of catchments to smoke-test the notebooks
hyd_test_mode <- FALSE
hyd_test_ids  <- c("03002", "03005", "03008")
```

```{r model-config}
# Primary model: GR4J (airGR), 4 parameters, daily
hyd_model        <- "GR4J"

# PET method: "oudin" (airGR::PE_Oudin; needs daily mean temperature + latitude)
# Alternative implemented below: "hargreaves" (Hargreaves-Samani 1985, needs
# tmax AND tmin + latitude). Both use only variables present in CAMELS-IND and
# in the bias-corrected CMIP6 series.
hyd_pet_method   <- "oudin"

# Streamflow: observed Q in m3/s -> model space mm/day via basin area (km2)
#   Q[mm/d] = Q[m3/s] * 86.4 / Area[km2]
hyd_m3s_to_mm_factor <- 86.4
```

```{r lib}
# Only catchments with a usable tier get modelled (tier1 + tier2; tier3 logged)
hyd_ok_tiers <- c("tier1", "tier2", "correct_with_warning")

# Hargreaves-Samani PET (mm/day), plain R alternative to Oudin.
# Ra = extraterrestrial radiation (mm/day equivalent), from latitude + DOY.
hyd_pet_hargreaves <- function(doy, tmax, tmin, lat_deg) {
   lat <- lat_deg * pi / 180
   dr  <- 1 + 0.033 * cos(2 * pi * doy / 365)          # earth-sun distance
   decl <- 0.409 * sin(2 * pi * doy / 365 - 1.39)      # solar declination
   x   <- pmin(pmax(-tan(lat) * tan(decl), -1), 1)     # guard acos domain
   ws  <- acos(x)                                      # sunset hour angle
   ra_mm <- (24 * 60 / pi) * 0.0820 * dr *
      (ws * sin(lat) * sin(decl) + cos(lat) * cos(decl) * sin(ws))  # MJ/m2/d
   ra_mm <- ra_mm * 0.408                              # -> mm/day equivalent
   0.0023 * ra_mm * (pmax((tmax + tmin) / 2 + 17.8, 0)) * pmax(tmax - tmin, 0) ^ 0.5
}

# CAMELS-IND uses 5-digit ids ("03001"); some tables carry 4-digit ("3001")
hyd_normalize_id <- function(x) {
   x <- trimws(as.character(x))
   ifelse(grepl("^[0-9]+$", x), sprintf("%05d", as.numeric(x)), x)
}

# Missing-value flags that must be treated as NA wherever they appear
hyd_missing_flags <- c(-999, -9999, -999.0)

# Timestamped log line
hyd_log <- function(msg, log_file = NULL) {
   line <- paste0(format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), " | ", msg)
   cat(line, "\n")
   if (!is.null(log_file)) cat(line, "\n", file = log_file, append = TRUE)
}

# Read a CAMELS forcing CSV with a Date column, replace missing flags with NA
hyd_read_forcing <- function(path) {
   dt <- data.table::fread(path, na.strings = c("NA", ""))
   dt[, date := as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", year, month, day))]
   for (col in c("prcp(mm/day)", "tmax(C)", "tmin(C)")) {
      if (col %in% names(dt)) {
         v <- dt[[col]]
         v[!is.na(v) & v %in% hyd_missing_flags] <- NA
         dt[, (col) := v]
      }
   }
   dt[]
}

# Read observed streamflow (wide table) and return the 5-digit-id column as
# m3/s with a Date index (missing flags -> NA)
hyd_read_q_obs <- function(id) {
   sf_dt <- data.table::fread(hyd_streamflow_fp,
                              select = c("year", "month", "day", sub("^0+", "", id)))
   data.table::setnames(sf_dt, sub("^0+", "", id), "q_m3s")
   v <- sf_dt$q_m3s
   v[!is.na(v) & v %in% hyd_missing_flags] <- NA
   sf_dt[, q_m3s := v]
   sf_dt[, date := as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", year, month, day))]
   sf_dt[, .(date, q_m3s)]
}
```
